<thought>The 13C NMR spectrum shows peaks in the aromatic region (≈110–160 ppm): 135.43, 130.70, 130.40, 128.70, 128.35, 124.85. Each of these appears twice, indicating two equivalent carbons for each shift. Therefore the compound contains 6 × 2 = 12 aromatic carbon atoms.</thought>
<final_answer>12</final_answer>
